name: Desert knows no rain
source:
Where a mighty river once roared, only dead sand remains.
Stranded in this lifeless wasteland, overcome by the heat and pain of memories, the two of you slog toward Shelter #15.
Will you make it there before the all-consuming Thirst claims you?

[From [url=https://asunaisu.itch.io/desert-knows-no-rain]itch.io[/url]]
